Notes:

*The temporary hit point increase is not a dis-spellable effect, nor does it have a timer like [[Bodyfeeder]] or [[Life Shield]]. It persists through [[rest]]s. It likely stacks with everything, though that has yet to be tested.

*All effects occur on hit, not on damage. [[DR]] can absorb all damage without preventing the effects.

*The level drain occurs whether the attack was melee or ranged. The curse and inflict wounds occurs only on melee attack. The temp HP is inconclusive at the moment.

*The [[Demonic Drain]] negative level affects warforged characters as well as others, but ''not'' [[Undead]] players (Pale Masters, Dark Apostates or the like.)  It is not blocked by [[Deathward]], but it can be removed with [[Restoration]].
